name: Interior cleaning board (2 weeks)
description: Our interior / home cleaning cadence — texts + emails over ~14 days (recurring jobs, booking, invoices, reviews, soft close). Shown as a flow graph on the Board tab.

stages.label: Day 0 · Text intro
stages.hint: First touch — recurring cleans + no-shows for home cleaning Pros.

stages.label: Day 1 · Email opener
stages.hint: Next day email — booking + schedule for cleaning teams.

stages.label: Day 3 · Text booking
stages.hint: Online booking for one-time and recurring cleans.

stages.label: Day 5 · Email get paid
stages.hint: Card on file / auto-pay so you leave with payment.

stages.label: Day 8 · Text pipeline
stages.hint: Quotes and move-out cleans going quiet — Pipeline follow-up.

stages.label: Day 11 · Email reviews + recurring
stages.hint: Review asks + bring past clients back on a cadence.

stages.label: Day 14 · Text soft close
stages.hint: Soft close — book a demo or leave it here.
